sources.label: Official A&F UK size guide (men's tops, product-page Size & Fit, UK region, cm)

audit: Was XS–XXL with single chest/waist values, UK 34–44 and EU sizes not on the UK chart. Official A&F UK men's tops chart gives only chest (cm ranges) and UK size, XXS–3XL; waist/US/EU removed. UK mapping changed (XS was UK 34 → 32-34, M 38 → 38-40, L 40 → 42, XL 42 → 44-46). M chest 97 → 95–103. Old /help-size-guide URL no longer resolves.
notes: US casual brand. A&F's UK chart gives chest only, with some letter sizes spanning two UK chest sizes (M = UK 38–40). Tall sizes are 5 cm longer in the body. Check the product-level fit description (slim vs classic) before buying.
